info.title: Exchange Rate Management System API
info.description: Spread-adjusted exchange rate calculator, historical rate and usage analytics, and AI-generated trend insight endpoints.

tags.name: Exchange Rate

post.summary: Manually trigger an out-of-schedule ingestion run (optional, FR-022)
post.description: Reuses the exact same idempotent upsert path as the daily scheduled job. MUST NOT read or write any Currency Usage Counter row under any outcome.

example.message: Manual refresh failed: Fixer.io /latest was unreachable

get.summary: Get the spread-adjusted exchange rate for a currency pair
get.description: Uses only locally stored data. If `date` is omitted, the most recent date with stored data for both currencies is used (FR-008). A same-currency pair (from == to) always returns exchange: 1 with no spread applied, and still increments that currency's usage counter once (FR-011).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Rate date (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, the most recent date with stored data for both currencies is used.

200.description: The spread-adjusted rate, with each currency's post-increment usage count.

404.description: No stored rate exists for one or both currencies on the resolved date (FR-009).

example.message: No rate data available for EUR/PLN on 2024-03-15

400.description: `from`/`to` is not a recognized currency code, or `date` is malformed (FR-010).

get.summary: Get an AI-generated trend commentary for a currency pair's rate movement
get.description: Grounds the model in the exact same (date, rate) series GET /api/exchange/history would return for this from/to/fromDate/toDate (constitution Principle X) — never a generic or templated response. A single-day range (fromDate == toDate) is described as one observation, not a multi-day trend. Has no side effects on usage counters and is not cached or persisted server-side.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range.

400.description: Unknown currency code, malformed date, or fromDate after toDate.

404.description: No stored rate data exists anywhere in the requested range — nothing to summarize.

example.message: No rate data available for EUR/PLN between 2024-02-01 and 2024-03-01

503.description: The local LLM call failed or timed out (model not running, connection refused, etc.). The rate data itself is unaffected and remains available via /api/exchange/history.

example.message: The trend insight could not be generated. The rate data itself is still available via /api/exchange/history.

get.summary: Get raw stored rates for a currency pair over a date range
get.description: Returns the spread-adjusted rate for every date in [startDate, endDate] that has usable stored data for both currencies; dates with no usable data are listed in `missingDates` instead of causing a failure — a partially incomplete range is still a 200 (User Story 2, Acceptance Scenario 5). Does not increment usage counters — usage tracking is scoped to single-pair /api/exchange lookups only.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the date range.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the date range.

404.description: Zero usable data points exist anywhere in the requested range.

example.message: No rate data available for EUR/PLN between 2024-03-01 and 2024-03-15

400.description: Unknown currency code, malformed date, or startDate after endDate.

200.description: The raw rates found, plus any dates with no usable data.

get.summary: Get usage statistics for every currency ever queried
get.description: Read-only — viewing analytics never itself counts as a query (FR-011's scope is /api/exchange lookups only). A currency never queried does not appear in the list at all; an empty list is returned (never 404) when no lookups have occurred yet.

200.description: Usage statistics, sorted by totalCount descending.

message.description: Human-readable detail for this specific occurrence.

triggeredAt.description: When this manual ingestion run was triggered.

exchange.description: The spread-adjusted rate: 1 unit of `from` converts to this many units of `to`. Always exactly 1 for a same-currency pair.

date.description: The rate date actually used — either the requested `date` or, if omitted, the most recent date with stored data for both currencies.

fromQueryCount.description: `from`'s running usage count, including this lookup.

toQueryCount.description: `to`'s running usage count, including this lookup.

fromDate.description: Inclusive start of the summarized date range.

toDate.description: Inclusive end of the summarized date range.

insight.description: The AI-generated commentary, grounded in the actual stored rate series for this exact pair and range.
insight.example: EUR/GBP softened by approximately 1.8% over this period, with the steepest decline in the final week of February.

date.description: The date this rate applies to.

fromRateToUsd.description: The source currency's own raw rate-to-USD as actually stored for this date. Null for a same-currency pair (no lookup is performed).

toRateToUsd.description: The target currency's own raw rate-to-USD as actually stored for this date. Null for a same-currency pair (no lookup is performed).

adjustedRate.description: The spread-adjusted pair rate on this date.

HistoricalRatePoint.description: One entry per date a rate could be computed for.

startDate.description: Inclusive start of the requested range.

endDate.description: Inclusive end of the requested range.

points.description: One entry per date a rate could be computed for.

missingDates.description: Dates within the range with no usable stored data for one or both currencies.

items.description: Dates within the range with no usable stored data for one or both currencies.

topCurrencies.description: Every currency ever queried, sorted by totalCount descending. Empty (never 404) if no lookups have occurred yet. A currency never queried does not appear at all.

currency.description: The currency this row's counts are for.

totalCount.description: Total number of successful /api/exchange lookups this currency has participated in, on either side of the pair.

lastQueried.description: The most recent date this currency was involved in a successful lookup.

CurrencyUsageEntry.description: Every currency ever queried, sorted by totalCount descending. Empty (never 404) if no lookups have occurred yet. A currency never queried does not appear at all.
